## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

| $`\eta^{e,+}`$ | `Store_efficiency_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — share of the energy drawn down that reaches the bus |
| $`\eta^{e,-}`$ | `Store_efficiency_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — share of the power drawn from the bus that becomes energy held |
| $`\mathrm{idle}^{e}`$ | `Store_inactive_snapshots` over $`\mathcal{V}`$ — how many snapshots a store is not active in. It is PyPSA's `(~active).sum()`, data prep. A cyclic store reaches back this many snapshots further, so it closes on the last snapshot it is active in |
| $`\mathrm{inflow}^{e}`$ | `Store_inflow` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — energy arriving per hour, a river into a reservoir |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{q}`$ | `Store_marginal_cost` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — cost of one unit of power delivered |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{q,+}`$ | `Store_marginal_cost_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — cost of one unit of discharge, `p + p_store` |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{q,(2)}`$ | `Store_marginal_cost_quadratic` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — cost of the square of the net power delivered, so charging costs as much as delivering |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{e}`$ | `Store_marginal_cost_storage` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — cost of one unit of energy held over one snapshot |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{q,-}`$ | `Store_marginal_cost_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — cost of one unit of charging, `p_store` |
| $`\mathrm{T}^{e}`$ | `Store_max_hours` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{V}`$, `absent` where the data has no row — energy capacity, as hours of discharge at the power rating. The rating is `e_nom / max_hours`. No value means PyPSA's default of infinity, and the store's power is then unbounded |
| $`\mathrm{open}^{e}`$ | `Store_opens_late` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — whether a snapshot is the first a store is active in, where that is not the first of the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `active.cumsum() == 1` over the snapshots it is active in, past the first snapshot. It is false in a run where every store is active throughout |
| $`\underline{\mathrm{q}}`$ | `Store_p_min_pu` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — most charging, per unit of the power rating, negated. It is PyPSA's `p_min_pu`, `-1` unless given, read only where `max_hours` has a value |
| $`\rho^{e}`$ | `Store_retention` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — share of energy kept over a snapshot. It is PyPSA's `(1 - standing_loss) ** elapsed hours`, data prep |
| $`\mathrm{sgn}^{q}`$ | `Store_sign` over $`\mathcal{V}`$ — the sign the power a store delivers enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `1` unless given. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`) |
| $`\mathrm{split}^{e}`$ | `Store_split_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{V}`$ — whether a store charges through `p_store` apart from its net dispatch `p`. It is PyPSA's `split_dispatch()`: true where an efficiency differs from one, a cost applies to one direction only, or `cycles_max` is finite, in any snapshot (`stores.py:88-116`), data prep. Where it is false, `p_store` is held at zero and the charging bound applies to `p` |
| $`\mathrm{on}^{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_active` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{M}`$ — whether a transformer is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep |
| $`\mathrm{act}^{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_active_asset` over $`\mathcal{M}`$ — whether a transformer is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`) |
| $`\mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_capital_cost` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{M}`$ — cost of one unit of nominal apparent power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`), data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`, where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`, `costs.py:102-203`) |
| $`\mathrm{W}^{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_capital_weight` over $`\mathcal{M}`$ — the sum of period weights a transformer is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`, summed, data prep |
| $`\overline{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_s_max_pu` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{M}`$ — most flow either way, per unit of nominal apparent power |
| $`\mathrm{ext}^{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_s_nom_extendable` over $`\mathcal{M}`$ — whether the nominal apparent power is a decision |
| $`\underline{\sigma}^{\mathrm{nom}}`$ | `Transformer_s_nom_min` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{M}`$ — least nominal apparent power an extendable transformer may be built at |
| $`\sigma^{\mathrm{mod}}`$ | `Transformer_s_nom_mod` over $`\mathcal{M}`$, `absent` where the data has no row — the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous |
| $`\mathrm{w}^{y}`$ | `period_weight_objective` over $`\mathcal{Y}`$ — PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`) |
| $`\pi`$ | `scenario_weight` over $`\Xi`$ — PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future |
| $`\mathrm{w}`$ | `snapshot_weightings_objective` over $`\mathcal{T}`$ — PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost |
| $`\mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{sto}}`$ | `snapshot_weightings_stores` over $`\mathcal{T}`$ — PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.stores` — hours a snapshot weighs in a storage balance |

#### Conditions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_curve` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: one of PyPSA's `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`) |
| $`\mathrm{StorageUnit\_ext}`$ | `StorageUnit_ext` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — a storage unit with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `ext` rows |

#### Variables

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`C^{\mathrm{curve}}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along a curve, held above the curve |
| $`p`$ | `Generator_p` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot |
| $`N^{s}`$ | `Line_n_mod` over $`\mathcal{K}`$ — `Line-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active has none |
| $`s`$ | `Line_s` over $`\mathcal{K} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Line-s` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Line_bus0` end: a positive value withdraws there and injects at `Line_bus1`, lossless |
| $`S`$ | `Line_s_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{K}`$ — `Line-s_nom` — nominal apparent power where it is a decision, for a line that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`f`$ | `Link_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Link-p` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value withdraws there and injects at every bus the link's output ports deliver to |
| $`z`$ | `Process_p` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Process-p` — PyPSA's internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive |
| $`N^{h}`$ | `StorageUnit_n_mod` over $`\mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active has none |
| $`h^{+}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus |
| $`H`$ | `StorageUnit_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a storage unit that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`h^{-}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge |
| $`\mathit{soc}`$ | `StorageUnit_state_of_charge` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot |
| $`e`$ | `Store_e` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-e` — energy held at the end of a snapshot |
| $`E`$ | `Store_e_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-e_nom` — nominal capacity where it is a decision, for a store that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`N^{e}`$ | `Store_n_mod` over $`\mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active has none |
| $`q`$ | `Store_p` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-p` — net power delivered to the bus. Charging is negative |
| $`q^{-}`$ | `Store_p_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — `Store-p_store` — power drawn from the bus to charge, so that `p + p_store` is the discharge. It is held at zero by its rows where the store does not split its dispatch |
| $`N^{\sigma}`$ | `Transformer_n_mod` over $`\mathcal{M}`$ — `Transformer-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active has none |
| $`\sigma`$ | `Transformer_s` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{M}`$ — `Transformer-s` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Transformer_bus0` end: a positive value withdraws there and injects at `Transformer_bus1`, lossless |
| $`\Sigma`$ | `Transformer_s_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{M}`$ — `Transformer-s_nom` — nominal apparent power where it is a decision, for a transformer that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |

#### Definitions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathit{Bus\_injection}`$ | `Bus_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_injection}`$ | `Generator_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_opex}`$ | `Generator_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}`$ | `Generator_running_cost` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a generator's output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`) |
| $`\mathit{Line\_capex}`$ | `Line_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Line\_injection}`$ | `Line_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_injection}`$ | `Link_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_capex}`$ | `StorageUnit_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}`$ | `StorageUnit_charge_carried_in` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}`$ | `StorageUnit_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}`$ | `StorageUnit_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Store\_capex}`$ | `Store_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathrm{Store\_charge\_cap\_pu}`$ | `Store_charge_cap_pu` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — the most charging through `p_store`, per unit of `e_nom`. It is `-p_min_pu / max_hours` for a store that splits its dispatch, and zero otherwise (`stores.py:79-86`) |
| $`\mathit{Store\_energy\_carried\_in}`$ | `Store_energy_carried_in` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{V}`$ — the energy a store opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given initial energy, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's less standing loss. A store built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon |
| $`\mathit{Store\_injection}`$ | `Store_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Store\_opex}`$ | `Store_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Transformer\_capex}`$ | `Transformer_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Transformer\_injection}`$ | `Transformer_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |
| $`\mathrm{pos}(t)`$ | `position()` — the position of $`t`$, counted from $`0`$; $`t`$ is the label |
| $`\mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{relation}(t)}(t)`$ | `position(within=relation[...])` — the position of $`t`$ inside its group |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`StorageUnit_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{StorageUnit\_ext}_{t,s} \iff \mathrm{ext}^{h}_{s} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s} \qquad \forall\, t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

```math
N^{s}_{k} \ge 0, N^{s}_{k} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, k \in \mathcal{K} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{s}_{k} \wedge \mathrm{s}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{k} > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}^{s}_{k}
```

**`StorageUnit_state_of_charge`**

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Line\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Store\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Transformer\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Line_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Line\_capex} = \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot S_{k} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},s}_{k,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{s}_{k}
```

**`Line_injection`**


    ```yaml
      Store_bus: {key: store, values: bus, description: the bus a store sits on}
      Transformer_bus0: {key: transformer, values: bus, description: the bus a transformer's flow is measured
          at}
      Transformer_bus1: {key: transformer, values: bus, description: the bus at a transformer's other end}
      snapshot_period: {key: snapshot, values: period, description: the investment period a snapshot falls
          in}
    parameters:
      Bus_attached:
        dims: [bus, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a load, a unit, a port or a branch that is active in the snapshot's period is
          attached to the bus, data prep. A bus nothing is attached to has no balance row
      Generator_active:
        dims: [generator, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a generator is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, from build
          year and lifetime, data prep
      Generator_active_asset:
        dims: [generator]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a generator is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Generator_committable:
        dims: [generator]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether output is gated by an on/off status decision
      Generator_marginal_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one unit of output
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p:
        dims: [breakpoint, generator]
        missing: absent
        description: 'the output at each breakpoint of a generator''s piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: PyPSA''s
          `p_pu` breakpoints times `p_nom`, data prep. A generator with no curve has no rows'
      Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of output
      Generator_p_max_pu:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'most output, per unit of nominal power: an availability profile'
      Generator_p_min_pu:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: least output, per unit of nominal power
      Generator_p_nom:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: nominal power
      Generator_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [generator]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal power is a decision
      Generator_sign:
        dims: [generator]
        description: the sign output enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `1` unless given,
          `-1` for a unit that draws power. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Line_active:
        dims: [line, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a line is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Line_active_asset:
        dims: [line]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a line is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Line_capital_cost:
        dims: [line, scenario]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal apparent power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Line_capital_weight:
        dims: [line]
        description: the sum of period weights a line is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Line_s_max_pu:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        description: most flow either way, per unit of nominal apparent power
      Line_s_nom_extendable:
        dims: [line]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal apparent power is a decision
      Line_s_nom_min:
        dims: [line, scenario]
        description: least nominal apparent power an extendable line may be built at
      Line_s_nom_mod:
        dims: [line]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      Link_active:
        dims: [link, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a link is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Link_committable:
        dims: [link]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether flow is gated by an on/off status decision
      Link_efficiency:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'share of the flow that arrives at an output port, PyPSA''s `efficiency`, `efficiency2`,
          … read long: negative where that port consumes rather than delivers. Read at the snapshot the flow
          arrives, so a delayed port delivers at its arrival snapshot''s efficiency (`constraints.py:1575`)'
      Link_marginal_cost:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one unit of flow
      Link_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of flow
      Link_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [link_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's flow wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's `cyclic_delay`,
          `cyclic_delay2`, …). Where it does not, the flow still in transit at each period's first snapshots
          is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Link_output_delay:
        dims: [link_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's delivery lags its link's flow (PyPSA's `delay`, `delay2`, … read long).
          In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round it up. It is
          zero for a port that delivers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario, because PyPSA
          refuses a delay that differs by scenario (`constants.py:55`)
      Link_p_max_pu:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: most flow, per unit of nominal power
      Link_p_min_pu:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'least flow, per unit of nominal power: negative for a link that carries both ways'
      Link_p_nom:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: nominal power
      Link_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [link]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal power is a decision
      Load_active:
        dims: [load]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a load is active in the network, PyPSA's `active`. A load has no build year and
          no lifetime, so the flag is the same in every snapshot. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario
          (`constants.py:54`)
      Load_p_set:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: demand
      Load_sign:
        dims: [load]
        description: the sign a load's demand enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `-1` unless
          given, `1` for a load that feeds its bus. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Process_active:
        dims: [process, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a process is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Process_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's transfer wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's
          `cyclic_delay0`, `cyclic_delay1`, …). Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's
          first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Process_output_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`,
          … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round
          it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario,
          as a link's port has
      Process_rate:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the energy a port draws or delivers per unit of internal power (PyPSA's `rate0`, `rate1`,
          … read long). It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a
          process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at
          the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's
          rate (`constraints.py:1575`)
      StorageUnit_active:
        dims: [snapshot, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a storage unit is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data
          prep
      StorageUnit_active_asset:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a storage unit is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone,
          without build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts.
          PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      StorageUnit_capital_cost:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      StorageUnit_capital_weight:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        description: the sum of period weights a storage unit is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the horizon closes on itself instead of opening on the initial charge
      StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period closes on itself instead of carrying its charge on to
          the next. It overrides `cyclic_state_of_charge` and `state_of_charge_initial_per_period`. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data prep
      StorageUnit_efficiency_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of the charge drawn down that reaches the bus
      StorageUnit_efficiency_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of the power drawn from the bus that becomes charge
      StorageUnit_inactive_snapshots:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: int
        description: how many snapshots a storage unit is not active in. It is PyPSA's `(~active).sum()`,
          data prep. A cyclic unit reaches back this many snapshots further, so it closes on the last snapshot
          it is active in
      StorageUnit_inflow:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: energy arriving per hour, a river into a reservoir
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of dispatch
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of dispatch. Storing is not charged
      StorageUnit_marginal_cost_storage:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: cost of one unit of charge held over one snapshot
      StorageUnit_max_hours:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: energy capacity, as hours of dispatch at nominal power
      StorageUnit_opens_late:
        dims: [snapshot, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a snapshot is the first a storage unit is active in, where that is not the first
          of the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `active.cumsum() == 1` over the snapshots it is active
          in, past the first snapshot. It is false in a run where every unit is active throughout
      StorageUnit_p_max_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: most dispatch, per unit of nominal power
      StorageUnit_p_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: most storing, per unit of nominal power and negated
      StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal power is a decision
      StorageUnit_p_nom_min:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: least nominal power an extendable storage unit may be built at
      StorageUnit_p_nom_mod:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      StorageUnit_retention:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: share of charge kept over a snapshot. It is PyPSA's `(1 - standing_loss) ** elapsed hours`,
          data prep
      StorageUnit_sign:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        description: the sign net dispatch enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `1` unless
          given. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        description: charge held before the first snapshot
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period opens on the initial charge instead of carrying the previous
          period's. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data
          prep
      Store_active:
        dims: [snapshot, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a store is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Store_active_asset:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a store is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone, without
          build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts. PyPSA
          refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Store_capital_cost:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal capacity for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Store_capital_weight:
        dims: [store]
        description: the sum of period weights a store is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Store_e_cyclic:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the horizon closes on itself instead of opening on the initial energy
      Store_e_cyclic_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period closes on itself instead of carrying its energy on to
          the next. It overrides `e_cyclic` and `e_initial_per_period`. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`.
          Otherwise you feed false in data prep
      Store_e_initial:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: energy held before the first snapshot
      Store_e_initial_per_period:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether each investment period opens on the initial energy instead of carrying the previous
          period's. PyPSA reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed false in data
          prep
      Store_e_max_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: most energy held, per unit of nominal capacity
      Store_e_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: 'least energy held, per unit of nominal capacity: negative for a store that may go short'
      Store_e_nom_extendable:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal energy capacity is a decision
      Store_e_nom_min:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        description: least nominal capacity an extendable store may be built at
      Store_e_nom_mod:
        dims: [store]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      Store_efficiency_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of the energy drawn down that reaches the bus
      Store_efficiency_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of the power drawn from the bus that becomes energy held
      Store_inactive_snapshots:
        dims: [store]
        dtype: int
        description: how many snapshots a store is not active in. It is PyPSA's `(~active).sum()`, data prep.
          A cyclic store reaches back this many snapshots further, so it closes on the last snapshot it is
          active in
      Store_inflow:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: energy arriving per hour, a river into a reservoir
      Store_marginal_cost:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of power delivered
      Store_marginal_cost_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of discharge, `p + p_store`
      Store_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of the square of the net power delivered, so charging costs as much as delivering
      Store_marginal_cost_storage:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of energy held over one snapshot
      Store_marginal_cost_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: cost of one unit of charging, `p_store`
      Store_max_hours:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        missing: absent
        description: energy capacity, as hours of discharge at the power rating. The rating is `e_nom / max_hours`.
          No value means PyPSA's default of infinity, and the store's power is then unbounded
      Store_opens_late:
        dims: [snapshot, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a snapshot is the first a store is active in, where that is not the first of
          the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `active.cumsum() == 1` over the snapshots it is active in,
          past the first snapshot. It is false in a run where every store is active throughout
      Store_p_min_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: most charging, per unit of the power rating, negated. It is PyPSA's `p_min_pu`, `-1`
          unless given, read only where `max_hours` has a value
      Store_retention:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: share of energy kept over a snapshot. It is PyPSA's `(1 - standing_loss) ** elapsed hours`,
          data prep
      Store_sign:
        dims: [store]
        description: the sign the power a store delivers enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`,
          `1` unless given. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Store_split_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        dtype: bool
        description: 'whether a store charges through `p_store` apart from its net dispatch `p`. It is PyPSA''s
          `split_dispatch()`: true where an efficiency differs from one, a cost applies to one direction only,
          or `cycles_max` is finite, in any snapshot (`stores.py:88-116`), data prep. Where it is false, `p_store`
          is held at zero and the charging bound applies to `p`'
      Transformer_active:
        dims: [snapshot, transformer]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a transformer is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data
          prep
      Transformer_active_asset:
        dims: [transformer]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a transformer is one of PyPSA's `active_assets`, by its `active` flag alone,
          without build year and lifetime. A unit that is active in no snapshot of the horizon still counts.
          PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:54`)
      Transformer_capital_cost:
        dims: [scenario, transformer]
        description: cost of one unit of nominal apparent power for the modelled horizon (PyPSA's `periodized_cost`),
          data prep. It is `overnight_cost` as an annuity over `lifetime` at `discount_rate`, times `nyears`,
          where `overnight_cost` is given, and `capital_cost` where it is not. Both add `fom_cost` (`components.py:1157-1178`,
          `costs.py:102-203`)
      Transformer_capital_weight:
        dims: [transformer]
        description: the sum of period weights a transformer is active in. It is PyPSA's `active * period_weighting`,
          summed, data prep
      Transformer_s_max_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        description: most flow either way, per unit of nominal apparent power
      Transformer_s_nom_extendable:
        dims: [transformer]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal apparent power is a decision
      Transformer_s_nom_min:
        dims: [scenario, transformer]
        description: least nominal apparent power an extendable transformer may be built at
      Transformer_s_nom_mod:
        dims: [transformer]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      period_weight_objective:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the
          column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`)
      scenario_weight:
        dims: [scenario]
        description: PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
      snapshot_weightings_stores:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.stores` — hours a snapshot weighs in a storage balance
    variables:
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Line_n_mod:
        dims: [line]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_s_nom_mod > 0 AND Line_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Line-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active
          has none'
      Line_s:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Line_active
        description: '`Line-s` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Line_bus0` end: a positive value
          withdraws there and injects at `Line_bus1`, lossless'
      Line_s_nom_ext:
        dims: [line]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active_asset
        description: '`Line-s_nom` — nominal apparent power where it is a decision, for a line that is active.
          A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      StorageUnit_n_mod:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_p_nom_mod > 0 AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`StorageUnit-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is
          not active has none'
      StorageUnit_p_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus'
      StorageUnit_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a storage unit that
          is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      StorageUnit_p_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge'
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot'
      Store_e:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-e` — energy held at the end of a snapshot'
      Store_e_nom_ext:
        dims: [store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset
        description: '`Store-e_nom` — nominal capacity where it is a decision, for a store that is active.
          A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Store_n_mod:
        dims: [store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_e_nom_mod > 0 AND Store_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Store-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not
          active has none'
      Store_p:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-p` — net power delivered to the bus. Charging is negative'
      Store_p_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        description: '`Store-p_store` — power drawn from the bus to charge, so that `p + p_store` is the discharge.
          It is held at zero by its rows where the store does not split its dispatch'
      Transformer_n_mod:
        dims: [transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_s_nom_mod > 0 AND Transformer_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Transformer-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is
          not active has none'
      Transformer_s:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: Transformer_active
        description: '`Transformer-s` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Transformer_bus0` end: a
          positive value withdraws there and injects at `Transformer_bus1`, lossless'
      Transformer_s_nom_ext:
        dims: [transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active_asset
        description: '`Transformer-s_nom` — nominal apparent power where it is a decision, for a transformer
          that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      Line_ext_s_lower:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active
        expression: Line_s >= (-Line_s_max_pu) * Line_s_nom_ext
        description: '`Line-ext-s-lower` — an extendable line carries at least the negative of its rating
          of the chosen build, the loss counted against it'
      Line_ext_s_nom_lower:
        dims: [line, scenario]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active_asset
        expression: Line_s_nom_ext >= Line_s_nom_min
        description: '`Line-ext-s_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Line_ext_s_upper:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active
        expression: Line_s <= Line_s_max_pu * Line_s_nom_ext
        description: '`Line-ext-s-upper` — an extendable line carries at most its rating of the chosen build,
          the loss included'
      Line_s_nom_modularity:
        dims: [line]
        where: Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_s_nom_mod > 0 AND Line_active_asset
        expression: Line_s_nom_ext == Line_s_nom_mod * Line_n_mod
        description: '`Line-s_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      StorageUnit_energy_balance:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        expression: ((StorageUnit_charge_carried_in + ((StorageUnit_efficiency_store * StorageUnit_p_store)
          * snapshot_weightings_stores)) - ((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * snapshot_weightings_stores) / StorageUnit_efficiency_dispatch))
          + (StorageUnit_inflow * snapshot_weightings_stores) == StorageUnit_state_of_charge
        description: '`StorageUnit-energy_balance` — the charge carried in, plus what is stored after its
          efficiency, less what dispatch draws down before its own, plus inflow not spilled'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_dispatch_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_dispatch-lower` — dispatch is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_dispatch_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch <= StorageUnit_p_max_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_dispatch-upper` — an extendable unit dispatches at most the chosen
          build'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [scenario, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        expression: StorageUnit_p_nom_ext >= StorageUnit_p_nom_min
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_store-lower` — storing is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store <= -StorageUnit_p_min_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-p_store-upper` — an extendable unit stores at most the chosen build,
          the minimum-per-unit column carrying that cap negated'
      StorageUnit_ext_state_of_charge_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-state_of_charge-lower` — charge is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_ext_state_of_charge_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_ext
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge <= StorageUnit_max_hours * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext
        description: '`StorageUnit-ext-state_of_charge-upper` — an extendable unit holds at most its hours
          at the chosen build'
      StorageUnit_p_nom_modularity:
        dims: [storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_p_nom_mod > 0 AND StorageUnit_active_asset
        expression: StorageUnit_p_nom_ext == StorageUnit_p_nom_mod * StorageUnit_n_mod
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Store_e_nom_modularity:
        dims: [store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_e_nom_mod > 0 AND Store_active_asset
        expression: Store_e_nom_ext == Store_e_nom_mod * Store_n_mod
        description: '`Store-e_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Store_energy_balance:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_active
        expression: ((Store_energy_carried_in - ((Store_p * snapshot_weightings_stores) / Store_efficiency_dispatch))
          + (((Store_efficiency_store - (1 / Store_efficiency_dispatch)) * Store_p_store) * snapshot_weightings_stores))
          + (Store_inflow * snapshot_weightings_stores) == Store_e
        description: '`Store-energy_balance` — the energy carried in, less the discharge drawn down before
          its efficiency, plus the charge after its own, plus inflow not spilled. The net dispatch `p` is
          the discharge less `p_store`, so `p_store` enters with both efficiencies (`constraints.py:2472-2476`)'
      Store_ext_e_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e >= Store_e_min_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-e-lower` — an extendable store holds at least its floor of the chosen build'
      Store_ext_e_nom_lower:
        dims: [scenario, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active_asset
        expression: Store_e_nom_ext >= Store_e_nom_min
        description: '`Store-ext-e_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Store_ext_e_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_e <= Store_e_max_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-e-upper` — an extendable store holds at most the chosen build'
      Store_ext_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active
        expression: Store_p_store >= 0
        description: '`Store-ext-p_store-lower` — charging is non-negative'
      Store_ext_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        where: Store_e_nom_extendable AND Store_active AND (NOT Store_split_dispatch OR Store_max_hours)
        expression: Store_p_store <= Store_charge_cap_pu * Store_e_nom_ext
        description: '`Store-ext-p_store-upper` — an extendable store charges at most the power rating of
          the chosen build where it splits its dispatch, and not at all where it does not. A store that splits
          and has no `max_hours` has no row'
      Transformer_ext_s_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active
        expression: Transformer_s >= (-Transformer_s_max_pu) * Transformer_s_nom_ext
        description: '`Transformer-ext-s-lower` — an extendable transformer carries at least the negative
          of its rating of the chosen build, the loss counted against it'
      Transformer_ext_s_nom_lower:
        dims: [scenario, transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active_asset
        expression: Transformer_s_nom_ext >= Transformer_s_nom_min
        description: '`Transformer-ext-s_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Transformer_ext_s_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active
        expression: Transformer_s <= Transformer_s_max_pu * Transformer_s_nom_ext
        description: '`Transformer-ext-s-upper` — an extendable transformer carries at most its rating of
          the chosen build, the loss included'
      Transformer_s_nom_modularity:
        dims: [transformer]
        where: Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_s_nom_mod > 0 AND Transformer_active_asset
        expression: Transformer_s_nom_ext == Transformer_s_nom_mod * Transformer_n_mod
        description: '`Transformer-s_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((((((Generator_injection + Line_injection) + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection)
          + StorageUnit_injection) + Store_injection) + Transformer_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Line_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Line_s_nom_ext * Line_capital_cost * Line_capital_weight)}
      Line_injection: {expression: '(-sum(Line_s, over=line, by=Line_bus0[bus])) + sum(Line_s, over=line,
          by=Line_bus1[bus])'}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      StorageUnit_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * StorageUnit_p_nom_ext * StorageUnit_capital_cost
          * StorageUnit_capital_weight)}
      StorageUnit_charge_carried_in:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is
          its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given
          initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's
          less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires
          closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon
        cases:
          cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: 'StorageUnit_retention * shift(shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot,
              offset=1, edge=''wrap''), along=snapshot, offset=StorageUnit_inactive_snapshots, edge=''wrap'')'}
          opening: {when: NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
          period_cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period, expression: 'StorageUnit_retention
              * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])'}
          period_opening: {when: 'StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) == 0', expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
        otherwise: StorageUnit_retention * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      StorageUnit_injection: {expression: 'sum(StorageUnit_sign * (StorageUnit_p_dispatch - StorageUnit_p_store),
          over=storage_unit, by=StorageUnit_bus[bus])'}
      StorageUnit_opex: {expression: '(sum(sum(((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot) +
          sum(sum((((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_p_dispatch) * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit),
          over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((StorageUnit_state_of_charge * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_storage) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot)'}
      Store_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Store_e_nom_ext * Store_capital_cost * Store_capital_weight)}
      Store_charge_cap_pu:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: the most charging through `p_store`, per unit of `e_nom`. It is `-p_min_pu / max_hours`
          for a store that splits its dispatch, and zero otherwise (`stores.py:79-86`)
        cases:
          split: {when: Store_split_dispatch, expression: -Store_p_min_pu / Store_max_hours}
        otherwise: '0'
      Store_energy_carried_in:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, store]
        description: the energy a store opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is
          its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given
          initial energy, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's
          less standing loss. A store built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that
          retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period
          as the horizon
        cases:
          cyclic: {when: Store_e_cyclic AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND NOT Store_e_initial_per_period
              AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR Store_opens_late), expression: 'Store_retention * shift(shift(Store_e,
              along=snapshot, offset=1, edge=''wrap''), along=snapshot, offset=Store_inactive_snapshots, edge=''wrap'')'}
          opening: {when: NOT Store_e_cyclic AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND NOT Store_e_initial_per_period
              AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR Store_opens_late), expression: Store_e_initial}
          period_cyclic: {when: Store_e_cyclic_per_period, expression: 'Store_retention * shift(Store_e, along=snapshot,
              offset=1, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])'}
          period_opening: {when: 'Store_e_initial_per_period AND NOT Store_e_cyclic_per_period AND position(snapshot,
              within=snapshot_period[period]) == 0', expression: Store_e_initial}
        otherwise: Store_retention * shift(Store_e, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Store_injection: {expression: 'sum(Store_sign * Store_p, over=store, by=Store_bus[bus])'}
      Store_opex: {expression: '(((sum(sum(((Store_p * Store_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Store_p
          * Store_p) * Store_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((Store_e * Store_marginal_cost_storage)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store),
          over=snapshot)) + sum(sum((((Store_p + Store_p_store) * Store_marginal_cost_dispatch) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=store), over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((Store_p_store
          * Store_marginal_cost_store) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]),
          over=store), over=snapshot)'}
      Transformer_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Transformer_s_nom_ext * Transformer_capital_cost
          * Transformer_capital_weight)}
      Transformer_injection: {expression: '(-sum(Transformer_s, over=transformer, by=Transformer_bus0[bus]))
          + sum(Transformer_s, over=transformer, by=Transformer_bus1[bus])'}
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: ((Generator_opex + Link_opex) + StorageUnit_opex) + Store_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: (((StorageUnit_capex + Store_capex) + Line_capex) + Transformer_capex) + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      StorageUnit_ext: {condition: StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active, description: a storage
          unit with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `ext` rows}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'StorageUnit_bus': relation(n, 'StorageUnit', 'bus'),
        'Store_bus': relation(n, 'Store', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
        'snapshot_weightings_stores': weighting(n, 'stores'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_63_modular_branches_and_storage.yaml', sources) as result:
        result.objective  # 13927.0
    ```

=== "PyPSA"

    The network, `rung_63_modular_branches_and_storage.py` in the corpus — the spine plus what this rung adds:

    ```python
    # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: mathspec Contributors
    #
    # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

    """Rung 63: modular branches and storage — a line, a transformer, a storage unit and a store each built in whole modules, beside a modular generator, link and process that are not active."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():
        """The spine plus an east bus fed over a modular line and a modular transformer, with a modular storage unit and store, and three inactive modular builds."""
        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'east')
        n.add(
            'Line', 'ne63', bus0='north', bus1='east', x=0.01, r=0.001, s_nom_extendable=True, s_nom_mod=25, capital_cost=3
        )
        n.add('Transformer', 'se63', bus0='south', bus1='east', x=0.01, s_nom_extendable=True, s_nom_mod=15, capital_cost=2)
        n.add(
            'StorageUnit',
            'battery63',
            bus='east',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_mod=15,
            max_hours=2,
            capital_cost=5,
            cyclic_state_of_charge=True,
        )
        n.add('Store', 'tank63', bus='east', e_nom_extendable=True, e_nom_mod=40, capital_cost=2, e_cyclic=True)
        n.add('Generator', 'east_backup63', bus='east', p_nom=200, marginal_cost=200)
        n.add('Load', 'east_load63', bus='east', p_set=[20, 70, 110, 40])
        idle = {'p_nom_extendable': True, 'p_nom_mod': 20, 'capital_cost': 1, 'marginal_cost': 1, 'active': False}
        n.add('Generator', 'idle_gen63', bus='east', **idle)
        n.add('Link', 'idle_link63', bus0='north', bus1='east', **idle)
        n.add('Process', 'idle_proc63', bus0='south', bus1='east', rate0=-1.25, **idle)
        return n
    ```
